name: Wakita & Co.,LTD.
summary: Wakita & Co.,LTD., engages in the construction equipment, trading, and real estate businesses in Japan and internationally. The company rents generators, welders, and compressors; cars and vehicle machines; road compaction machines; concrete equipment, light machinery tools, earthmoving and heavy machinery, and machines for soil improvement and foundation construction; submersible pumps and water treatment equipment; and small lifting, carrying, and house equipment.
